evals.name: write-new-adr
evals.prompt: We decided to store visit recordings encrypted in S3 with a separate key per family instead of as database blobs, because keys must be revocable when a sibling leaves. The cost is more code and key-management work. Write this up so the team can find it later.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Produces a record with context, decision, options considered, and consequences
Lists database blobs as a rejected option with a reason
Lists at least one downside or cost in the consequences
Marks the status as Proposed or asks the user to accept it, rather than marking it Accepted on its own

evals.name: supersede-old-adr
evals.prompt: We are replacing ADR-0003 (self-hosted Postgres) with managed Postgres. Update the records.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Creates a new record instead of rewriting the decision in ADR-0003
Marks ADR-0003 as superseded and links the old and new records to each other
Uses or asks for the next free record number
Leaves the new record Proposed until the user agrees, or asks for the user's confirmation

evals.name: trivial-change
evals.prompt: I renamed a variable from usr to user in two files and fixed a typo in a comment. Should I write an architecture decision record for this?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Says no record is needed for this change
Gives a reason tied to the change being trivial or nobody needing to look it up later
Does not draft a full decision record
Names at least one kind of change that would need a record (for example choosing a technology or setting a rule others must follow)
